means: Ordering claims about repoScore that must hold in the LIVE index. Each is a judgement a person can argue with — that is the point: the ranking model is tuned against a written answer key, not against whichever number looks nicer this week. A pair fails when the live scores contradict it; a pair whose repos are missing is could-not-check, never a pass.

pairs.why: The SDK a stranger should be handed, versus a hackathon submission. This pair inverted on 2026-09-07 (76 vs 85) and is the reason the key exists.
The network's reference implementation must outrank a judged hackathon entry with no project link.
A live lending protocol on Stellar (21 stars) over a generic mnemonic tool with 4,314 stars and no Stellar code. Popularity elsewhere is not authority here.
The Soroban Rust SDK over a multi-chain wallet monorepo the scanner found no Stellar code in.
9,248 stars earned in a different ecosystem do not make a better Stellar reference.
A deployed AMM over a hackathon game, both Soroban, one with a product behind it.

An unfunded, unstarred TypeScript toolkit — 95 commits in 90 days, a release the same day, tests, CI, a supported SDK pin and six knowledge notes — over a judged hackathon submission. Nobody funded colibri and it has 3 stars, which is exactly why it scored 35 while the hackathon entry scored 68. An award is a past funding decision, not evidence the code works.

The XDR codec every Stellar SDK is built on, published by SDF, over a hackathon game. SDF never receives an SCF award — it awards them — so all 212 first-party repos scored as though nothing vouched for them. js-xdr also imports no soroban-sdk (a codec does not), so the relevance filter cut its evidence to a quarter. It scored 31.
The official Stellar documentation over a judged hackathon entry. Tests the same first-party blindness on a repo with no Soroban code at all.

Chainlink's official Stellar integration — 167 commits in 90 days, tests, CI, releases, 48 contract methods, 0 stars because the repo is new under a large org — over a generic mnemonic tool with 4,314 stars and no Stellar code. Zero stars is not zero evidence when we have read the code.

The API server the whole ecosystem queries (9 stars) over a hackathon repo pinned to a deprecated Stellar SDK. A dead SDK pin is an affirmative finding about a reference's quality, not a missing datum.
